title: Discovery Elbow Long-Term Survivorship
brief_summary: The Discovery™ Elbow Multi-Center Prospective Study (5-year Study) patients will be consented at the two year or next scheduled follow-up period for the early-enrolled patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Participant in the Discovery Elbow Multi-center Study
2. Consent to participate in the Discovery Elbow Long-Term Survivorship Study

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Patient is not a Discovery Elbow Multi-center Participant
2. Patient does not provide consent for the Discovery Elbow Long-term Survivorship Study
study_population: The Study population shall be participanting in the Discovery Elbow Multi-center Study who provide consent for the Discovey Elbow Long-term Survivoship Study
